profile.headline: Software Engineer at Applied Materials
profile.summary:
IT professional in the semiconductor industry with extensive experience troubleshooting high-stakes production issues for wafer fabs and other customers. I have experience deploying MES software as a systems administrator at Texas Instruments, as well as helping customers deploy MES software as an application engineer at Applied Materials. 

I have a strong interest in online privacy & security and incorporate this mindset into my work.

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description: System admin customer support for US-based customers of Applied Materials 300works and MES for ATP applications. Supported installation, configuration, integration, and software support of the MES applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for installing and maintaining MES software and Apache Pulsar Message Bus architecture. Specializing in successful factory startup in relation to fab-critical applications and for identifying and mitigating IT security risks across owned applications.
positions.insights: Oracle Database, Linux System Administration and +3 skills

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description: Application Developer responsible for integrating MES software into new fabs. Using a large variety of software on Windows and Linux systems and demonstrating technical skills in SQL and Linux scripting.

positions.title: Mainframe Developer
positions.description:
Worked collaboratively with team to solve hard-coded limitation problems within homegrown mainframe environment. 

Brainstormed solutions for template limitations. 

Created copybook code for use across any program where new solution was needed.
